newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon upgrades Portugal's Telecel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon upgrades Portugal's Telecel.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it was upgrading Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel from hold to buy and predicted a price of 16,500 escudos per share within 12 months.
The stock was trading down 100 escudos at 14,450 on Friday in turnover of just 4,889 shares.
In a research note, the investment house said that it had decided on the upgrade because of good first half results and particularly the sharp growth in the number of subscribers.
The company said that it had previously expected the company to reach 500,000 subscribers by end-1997, however this figure now seemed too low and had been revised upwards to 625,000.
It said that Telecel was trading at a 17 percent discount to Italy's TIM on a firm value/EBITDA ratio and at a 51 percent discount on the basis of price-earnings.
It gave the following forecasts in billions of escudos except for EPS which is expressed in escudos and firm value/EBITDA and price-earnings which are ratios:
Revenues EBITDA Net Income EPS FV/EBITDA P/E
